name: Security Instrument Description 23
definition: Identifies the security instrument by its name and typical characteristics.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the financial instrument using an ISIN.

OtherIdentification.name: Other Identification
OtherIdentification.definition: Identification of a security by proprietary or domestic identification scheme.

FullName.name: Full Name
FullName.definition: Full name or description of the financial instrument.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO classification of financial instrument (CFI) codification, that is common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

NotionalCurrency.name: Notional Currency
NotionalCurrency.definition: Currency in which the notional is denominated.
